verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an API-driven card-issuing platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an Adyen CLI. The documented interfaces are the REST APIs (such as /paymentInstruments), the web-based Customer Area, mobile SDKs and an llms.txt docs file, none of which is a command-line tool.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
